_source: Every value re-derived from the live laclinicdental.com pages on 2026-07-30. Where the live site contradicts itself the conflict is recorded, not silently resolved.
name: LACLINIC DENTAL

address._geo: Taken from the Google Maps embed on /afspraak-maken (place: LACLINIC Dental).

hours._conflict: F-002. The footer states ZAT Gesloten on every page. The FAQ states 'ook op zaterdag' twice, on / and on /afspraak-maken. Resolved to CLOSED on the footer's authority — it is the structured, deliberate statement, and the failure mode is safe. Requires client confirmation before launch; see CLIENT_ACTIONS.md.

booking._conflict: F-003. The homepage renders two hero variants pointing at two different destinations: /afspraak-maken (desktop) and the Doctena listing (mobile). Same label, two targets.
booking._note: Every CTA on this site points at the internal /afspraak-maken route. That page carries the two routes that work without a backend: phone, and the Doctena scheduler. The live site's own form is a callback request, not a scheduler — it collects details and the practice rings back — and this build ships no forms backend (§12).
